label: preparing
what: Likely coordinated preparations for a community gathering involving baking with separately supplied grain and a twenty-emerald baking quote. The builder met the freight operator and baker and sought the innkeeper; the innkeeper has arranged a civic-hospitality committee meeting tomorrow at eighteen in the great hall. Whether these are the same undertaking, its actual occasion, and the committee membership remain unconfirmed. Secretary knowingly helps arrange the meeting and escort, but is not shown to know any undisclosed purpose. No evidence that neighbour knowingly helps preparations.
